entities.summary: Antal Ruprecht or Anton Leopold Ruprecht (1748–1818) was a Hungarian chemist. He established a laboratory and conducted analyses of minerals at the Mining Academy of Schemnitz and later at the University of Pavia. He claimed to have found a method for reducing some metal ores but this was claimed by Martin Klaproth to be incorrect.
